## History

Prior to [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) Barry's illness, Mary Joe had never seen anyone with the croup. When the [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) parents were away and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) was out, Mary Joe was present during the night [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) fell severely ill, leaving [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) to seek [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's help. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully treated the baby using her prior experience until [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) arrived with a doctor.

## Relationships

### [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grandma-irving--mary-joe.md)

Mary Joe serves under [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md) as a domestic worker at her home. She assists with the household duties, including helping prepare and serve tea when visitors like [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) come to visit the [Irving](../character/irving.md) residence.

- Serves under (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P10](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0010)</sub>
